messages.text: The expanded run is doing its job: most reported failures collapse to one quoting rule—eza double-quotes any name containing a single quote—and one mode rule—`COLUMNS` makes redirected default/recursive output grid-capable. I’m fixing those shared causes first, then I’ll use the remaining failure list to distinguish true implementation gaps from platform-inapplicable Rust fixtures instead of patching individual cases.
